title: shorea ovalis
intro: Shorea ovalis, commonly known as the Balau tree, is a species of tree in the family Dipterocarpaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Southeast Asian medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Shorea ovalis include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of Shorea ovalis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
